title: Cold rebuild: context-aware encoding
summary: Rebuild the encoded search page from memory, no hints.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: You encoded the **search page** in *XSS and output encoding*: one value, four contexts. Write it again from an
**empty editor**. The tests are the ones you passed, a payload for every context included.
If you get stuck, go back to the lesson and try again tomorrow. This check, plus the boss, proves the module.

steps.title: Rebuild the search page cold
prompt: `GET /search?q=...` answers `text/html` with exactly these four lines (after `<!doctype html>`), with `q` encoded for each context:
**From memory:** `using System.Text.Encodings.Web;` and the right encoder in each place.
